notes: v1.5.95: Fixed creation mode selection event handling to prevent spurious 'already in that mode' toasts and ensure 'New Character' modal correctly initializes characters. Re-categorized five Doctor Doom items (Combat Doombot, Diplomatic Doombot, Latverian Servo-Guard, Pacifier Riot-Control Robot, Swarmbots) from Battlesuits to Robots. Consolidated Armor force fields (Insulato-Shield Belt Emitter, Neuro-Space Field Inhibitor) and Armor & Suits items into 'Protective Items and Suits'.
